risk_flags.reason: scripts/migrate-tighten-description-topic.js performs a table-swap on `documents` — a Parent-of-Sacred table — via `DROP TABLE documents` (diff lines 27-28). With SQLite foreign keys enabled, DROP TABLE fires an implicit row delete that triggers ON DELETE CASCADE into `questions` and through it `session_answers` (both sacred). This is the exact shape of the 2026-04-27 incident that destroyed 790 questions and 746 answers, and it executed against the live DB (migration-output.txt shows it already ran).

The script ran (evidence/migration-output.txt) and DROP TABLE documents is irreversible without PITR. Verification only counted `documents` rows (22→22) and never checked `questions` or `session_answers`; doctrine §4 states cascades make dependent tables part of the operation, so the acceptance criterion 'no data loss anywhere' is unverified and possibly already violated.

DEC-U06 pre-approval reads 'close-out: tighten documents schema — small, low-risk' — this is innocent framing, not an enumerated, specific pre-approval for a DROP-TABLE table-swap on a Parent-of-Sacred table. The new schema (files diff lines 14-24) also silently drops any foreign-key definitions and any columns not in the explicit INSERT...SELECT list (lines 25-26), discarding constraints/data without approval.
